meta.name: The Greatest Lie Ever Sold George Floyd And The Rise Of BLM
meta.description: In the aftermath of George Floyd’s death, the media concocted a narrative that justified a summer of worldwide riots and helped contribute to the rise of Black Lives Matter who used the chaos to raise 90 million dollars. In this documentary, Candace Owens follows the money and discovers exactly how the money was spent and where it did—and didn’t go.
meta.slogan: George Floyd and the Rise of BLM
